Evan Brooks: Quick Q — I submitted an expense for the UK client visit and Concur flagged it. I used a personal card for a lounge fee + meals. Statement shows merchant as "Heathrow Lounge Ltd" for £56.00 (card last4 8812) but Concur shows $69.84 and a separate FX fee line of $1.75. Are bank FX/foreign transaction fees reimbursable? Attached receipt + statement: <https://drive.redwood.com/receipts/evan-htlounge-05-03.pdf>

Alex Torres: Hi Evan — standard policy: out-of-pocket FX fees on personal cards are reimbursable when they are explicit bank charges tied to an approved business expense. We need the merchant receipt in local currency and the bank statement line showing the FX fee as a separate entry.

Evan Brooks: Uploaded both: merchant receipt (shows £56.00) and my bank conversion lines (shows converted amount and the FX fee): <https://drive.redwood.com/statements/evan-may-stmt.png>. Also attached boarding pass for client trip. Tagging Priya for approval @Priya Singh

Priya Singh: Confirming this was client on-site 2024-05-03 to 2024-05-04. Meals + lounge were business-related. Approved for reimbursement including the explicit FX bank charge. ✅

Alex Torres: Finance note: we'll reimburse the merchant charge plus the explicit FX fee up to $25 per trip. For FX fees above that, we escalate to Treasury for review. Calculation for Evan: merchant £56.00 -> $69.84 (as converted) + FX bank fee $1.75 = total $71.59. Use memo code EXP-PERD-INTL. Created ticket #FIN-4338 to track currency/fee exception.

Finance Bot: Thanks everyone 30 Request recorded under #FIN-4338. Reimbursement scheduled: $71.59 on payroll cycle 2024-06-01. Note: if you use Redwood corpcard in future, FX fees are covered by Redwood. For recurring international travel, request pre-approval for lounge/club memberships. Closing thread.
